description: This Python source file implements transformation logic for converting OpenAI-style embedding requests into Bedrock TwelveLabs Marengo format, supporting both synchronous and asynchronous invoke routes. It includes classes and methods for parameter mapping, request transformation, response parsing, and handling async invocation metadata.

classes.name: TwelveLabsMarengoEmbeddingConfig
